models.name: shopping_mall_configurations
models.description:
Platform-wide configuration entries managing system parameters, feature flags, and constants.

Allows admin-only CRUD of key-value structured settings that control feature toggles, global options, or business parameters for the entire shopping mall backend. Heavily referenced by all modules, with audit and soft deletion required for traceability.

plainFields.name: config_key
plainFields.description: Unique configuration key name, used in service and API lookup. Recommended to namespace with prefixes by category or domain.

plainFields.name: config_value
plainFields.description: String or JSON-serialized value. Raw storage; business logic interprets entry per config_key.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed explanation of the configuration's role and effect for admin reference.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: active, inactive, or deprecated—for admin gating and safe rollout/testing.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of row creation (audit trail).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last mutation timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete marker for removed/legacy entries.

models.name: shopping_mall_categories
models.description:
Product and navigation category taxonomy, supporting arbitrarily deep nesting via self-referencing parent_id.

Each category row is used for user browsing, search filters, and system reference. Parent categories have parent_id = null. Admins manage category CRUD and soft delete for cross-domain stability.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Self-foreign key for category hierarchy—null for root categories. Cascades to build full tree structure.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Unique category name, as seen in UIs and for API reference.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Long-form description of purpose and coverage for admin/merchandiser context.

plainFields.name: sort_order
plainFields.description: Ordering for navigation and display; lower values first.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: active/inactive/deprecated for admin approval or programmatic use.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Audit trail—creation moment.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last admin/edit update.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete for safe deactivation.

models.name: shopping_mall_external_payment_providers
models.description:
Registered external payment providers for all enabled checkout flows and payment methods.

Defines all payment gateways/platforms (e.g., Stripe, Toss, PayPal) integrated by admin and referenced in order/payment tables. Directly managed by admins for status, audit, and usable methods in commerce flows. CRUD enabled via admin tools; uses status and soft delete to manage reconfiguration and deprecation safely. Uniquely keyed by provider_name and provider_code.

plainFields.name: provider_name
plainFields.description: Display name as shown in checkout UIs—unique for each provider.

plainFields.name: provider_code
plainFields.description: System integration key/code—unique for backend mapping and API orchestration.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: active/inactive/deprecated—controls available methods/platforms in UX.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Legal/business context and integration notes for provider.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp (for audit).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update (admin/edit context).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete—row remains for historical audit/logging.

models.name: shopping_mall_shipping_partners
models.description:
Official platform registry for logistics/shipping partners in buyer and seller flows.

All partners that can be used for order shipments, available for admin CRUD and for use in shipment, order, or tracking-related tables via FKs. Managed for status and audit; supports deprecation via soft delete but keeps historical/inactive partners visible for audit and referencing legacy data.

plainFields.name: partner_name
plainFields.description: Display name (UI/reference); unique.

plainFields.name: partner_code
plainFields.description: Integration code for backend (system use); unique.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: active/inactive/deprecated—admin only control.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Business and operational info about the partner.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation moment (audit).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Mutation/audit update time.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete for legacy/decommissioned partners.

models.name: shopping_mall_customers
models.description:
Registered customer account representing a buyer on the platform.

Holds personal and authentication data, including email for login, password hash, and registration status. Is the actor for all end-customer business flows. Each customer can maintain multiple addresses, and all cart, wish, and order histories are tied to this entity. A unique email is required per customer. Authentication audit enabled via related session table. Soft delete is omitted by business policy (hard delete only via admin action).

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Customer's email address used for authentication and communication. Must be unique across all customers.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Bcrypt hash of the customer's login password. Used for secure authentication; plain passwords are never stored.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Customer's legal full name for identification and order fulfillment.

plainFields.name: phone
plainFields.description: Customer's primary phone number for order and support contacts.

plainFields.name: is_email_verified
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the customer has completed email verification.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Account creation timestamp in UTC.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last time customer record was updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_sessions
models.description:
Session token records for authenticated customer logins.

Tracks each web or mobile login, holding the session's connection context for audit and security. Linked to customers via customer_id, with composite index for fetch. Expired sessions denote logouts or security expiry. No extra metadata is included for device/user-agent; only core IP/href/referrer for compliance. Subsidiary stance to customer records; maintains audit trail.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: References the customer owning this session. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address for the client initiating the session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Original connection URL when the session was created.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL for the session's origin context.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp in UTC.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration UTC time; null if currently active.

models.name: shopping_mall_sellers
models.description:
Registered seller account with legal business identity and verification status.

Holds core authentication and business contact information including unique email, password hash, business name, registration number, status, and compliance flag. Only verified sellers can onboard products. Each seller may have multiple addresses linked by the addresses table. Seller dashboards and product/inventory are strictly partitioned by this entity.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Seller's unique login email. Used for authentication and main point of contact.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Bcrypt hash of the seller's login password. Plaintext passwords are never stored.

plainFields.name: business_name
plainFields.description: Legal business name of the seller. Required for all compliance and public catalog exposure.

plainFields.name: registration_number
plainFields.description: Government-issued business registration or license number. Used for KYC and compliance.

plainFields.name: business_phone
plainFields.description: Official business contact phone number for support and notifications.

plainFields.name: is_email_verified
plainFields.description: Indicates whether seller has verified their email address.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Seller account status: pending, approved, rejected, suspended, etc., as enforced by admin and business workflow.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Account creation timestamp in UTC.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last time seller account was updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_sessions
models.description:
Authenticated session records for sellers accessing their dashboard or API.

Logs each session for audit and security tracking. Linked to sellers by seller_id. Key attributes are connection metadata: IP, href, and referrer. Session expiry supports both manual logout and automatic timeout. All business-side actions are traced back to session for compliance. Subsidiary to sellers.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: References seller owning this session. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address for this session's origin.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Source URL of the session creation event.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL for context at login.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiry datetime, or null if still active.

models.name: shopping_mall_admins
models.description:
Platform administrator account with root governance permissions.

Stores admin authentication, contact details, and activation status. Admin creation and updates are allowed only by other admins as per strict business rules. Used for all high-privilege actions including dispute, refund, platform configuration, and moderation. Email is unique per admin.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email for authentication and notification. Required for all admin communication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Admin's password hash for login authentication. Never holds plaintext.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Admin's full name for auditing, contact, and action logs.

plainFields.name: is_email_verified
plainFields.description: Indicates whether admin email was verified/activated.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Admin account status; defines access: active, suspended, revoked, etc.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Datetime when admin account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Datetime when last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_sessions
models.description:
Session logs for each authenticated admin dashboard/API login.

Every instance records IP, entry URL, and referrer for each session. Session expiry signals logout/invalidation. Indexed by admin_id for audit purposes. Subsidiary to admin with strict linkage; key for compliance and oversight.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin user associated to this session. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Originating IP address for this admin session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Access URL at session start.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL when login occurred.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session created at timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration datetime, or null if still active.

models.name: shopping_mall_addresses
models.description:
Address book entry for shipping, billing, or business association for any user actor.

Each record details the full structured address: full name, street, city, province/state, postal code, country, and phone. Customer addresses are required; sellers may also have addresses for business documentation. Each address is linked to either a customer or a seller (never both), with at least one being non-null. Each user can hold up to 10 addresses. Optionally flagged as the default address. Soft deletes not supported—records are permanent unless directly erased.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: FK to owning customer, if this is a customer address. Nullable if belongs to a seller. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: FK to owning seller, if this is a seller address. Nullable if owned by a customer. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: full_name
plainFields.description: Recipient's name for shipping or billing purposes.

plainFields.name: street
plainFields.description: Street address, including building/unit number as applicable.

plainFields.name: city
plainFields.description: City for the address.

plainFields.name: province
plainFields.description: Province, state, or administrative region.

plainFields.name: postal_code
plainFields.description: ZIP/postal code formatted by country.

plainFields.name: country
plainFields.description: Country name in ISO standard or local language.

plainFields.name: phone
plainFields.description: Contact phone number for delivery issues.

plainFields.name: is_default
plainFields.description: Indicates if this is the actor's default address.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Address creation timestamp.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_verifications
models.description:
KYC/business verification status records for each seller actor.

Stores the state and reason for seller verification processing (e.g., pending, approved, rejected) and reviewer/admin audit trail. Contains all compliance documents and correspondence references submitted by the seller. Required for permission to list products. Each seller has one or more verifications over time, all records append-only. Status, reviewer, and all timestamps included for workflow traceability.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller under verification. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: reviewer_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin who reviewed or verified this record. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Verification status: pending, approved, rejected, under_review, needs_more_info, etc.

plainFields.name: compliance_documents
plainFields.description: Documentation references or IDs for KYC or compliance. May be null during initial request.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Notes explaining state, rejection, or administrative requirements. May be null if not needed.

plainFields.name: reviewed_at
plainFields.description: Datetime when this record was reviewed/decisioned.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

models.name: shopping_mall_role_escalations
models.description:
Records of all privilege/role escalation requests and admin actions for platform actors.

Each record represents a direct request or admin-initiated alteration for increased privileges, e.g., customer-to-seller, seller-to-admin. Stores requestor, target role/status, current processing status, admin/actor attribution, processed result, and action logs for audit. Enables strict privilege boundary enforcement under supervision. Full append-only audit maintained.

foreignFields.name: requestor_actor_id
foreignFields.description: FK to customer, if requestor is a customer. May be null for seller/admin escalations. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: requestor_seller_id
foreignFields.description: FK to seller, if requestor is a seller. Nullable for customer/admin initiated. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: processed_by_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin who processed/escalated this event if applicable. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: target_role
plainFields.description: Role requested by the escalator (customer, seller, admin, etc.).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Escalation status: pending, approved, rejected, under_review, revoked, etc.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Notes, justification, or admin comments for this role change request.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Role escalation request creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: processed_at
plainFields.description: Datetime when request was processed/decisioned.

models.name: shopping_mall_products
models.description:
Top-level catalog entity representing a unique product offered on the platform.

Each product record defines the core business information for listing in the marketplace, including title, description, price, and owner seller reference (as a foreign key to sellers in another domain component already created). Products are assigned to one or more categories via a separate mapping table. Multiple variant SKUs and images are associated with each product, reflecting available purchase options and media assets. The product table includes status fields (e.g., draft, published, archived), audit fields for full lifecycle traceability (created, updated, deleted times), and is the anchor point for all product filtering, search, and analytics.

Soft delete is supported for recovery and moderation workflows.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Owning seller for this product. References the {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Public product name, shown in catalog and search results.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed product description, with rich text and formatting if allowed by system.

plainFields.name: default_price
plainFields.description: Default display price for product overview (actual purchase price may be per SKU/variant).

plainFields.name: business_status
plainFields.description: Workflow status string; valid values: draft, published, archived, blocked, pending_approval, etc.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: UTC timestamp for product creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: UTC timestamp for last modification of this product.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete marker; null if product is active, set when product is deleted/archived.

models.name: shopping_mall_products_categories
models.description:
Junction table mapping multi-category assignments for each product.

Associates each product with one or more marketplace categories, supporting hierarchical or multi-category navigation, search, and filtering. Each row represents the membership of a single product in a single category. Indexes support efficient filtering and common lookup patterns.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Mapped catalog product. References {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_category_id
foreignFields.description: Assigned marketplace category. References {@link shopping_mall_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: UTC timestamp for mapping creation.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_skus
models.description:
Individual SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) for a specific variant or option of a catalog product.

Each SKU represents a unique variant of a product (e.g., color, size, option combinations), with independent inventory, price, and status. SKUs are linked to the parent product and to their attribute values (via subsidiary mapping table). Inventory, per-SKU pricing, out-of-stock flags, and barcode/business reference codes are managed here. SKUs are included in search and filtering.

Audit, status, and soft delete fields support traceability, operation, and moderation.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Parent catalog product for this SKU. References {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: sku_code
plainFields.description: Unique business SKU/barcode identifier within a product scope.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Sale price for this variant (overrides product default price if present).

plainFields.name: stock
plainFields.description: Inventory units available for this SKU.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Workflow status for SKU (e.g., active, out_of_stock, archived, draft).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: UTC timestamp for SKU creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: UTC timestamp for last SKU change.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete flag: null if active, set when archived/deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_images
models.description:
Image/media asset records associated with products or SKUs.

Each row stores a single image file or media asset for a specific product or SKU. Images support position-based ordering (e.g., main image, gallery order), alt text for accessibility, CDN/URI reference, and a label for internal management. Can attach images directly to product or specific SKU using foreign key, but never both at the same time (business logic ensures this). 

Audit fields and soft delete are included for digital asset lifecycle.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product that this image is associated with. Nullable if this is a SKU-specific image.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_sku_id
foreignFields.description: SKU variant this image is associated with. Nullable if this is a product-level image.

plainFields.name: cdn_uri
plainFields.description: CDN or publicly accessible URI for the image media.

plainFields.name: alt_text
plainFields.description: Accessibility/text alternative for the image, shown on error/load fail.

plainFields.name: position
plainFields.description: Image display position ordering for carousels/galleries. Lower values displayed first.

plainFields.name: label
plainFields.description: System/business management label (not shown to end users).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: UTC timestamp for asset creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: UTC timestamp for any update to asset.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete marker: null if active, set when removed/archived.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_attributes
models.description:
Dictionary of attribute types supported for variant construction in the catalog (e.g., color, size, material, option labels).

Defines the allowed attributes for SKUs under each product, managed separately from global attributes. Provides structure and display name for each attribute type, supports ordering in variant selection UIs, and ties to allowed values in the mapping table. Each attribute is linked to exactly one product.

Audit and soft delete fields for traceability.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product for which this attribute is used. References {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: attribute_name
plainFields.description: Logical name for this attribute (e.g., color, size); visible in variant picker.

plainFields.name: position
plainFields.description: Display order for attribute in UI context. Lower appears first.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: UTC timestamp for attribute creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: UTC timestamp for last update of attribute.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete marker: null if active, set for attribute removal.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_attribute_values
models.description:
Link table mapping (for each SKU) the value of a particular attribute (e.g., red for color, XL for size) in variant construction.

Each row records the value of an attribute for a specific SKU, allowing the flexible definition of multi-attribute variants per SKU. Enables full filter and product option selection. Provides value name/label, audit fields, and supports multiple values per attribute/SKU mapping.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_sku_id
foreignFields.description: SKU instance for which this attribute value is defined. References {@link shopping_mall_product_skus.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_attribute_id
foreignFields.description: Corresponding attribute type for this value. References {@link shopping_mall_product_attributes.id}.

plainFields.name: value_display_name
plainFields.description: Renderable text for value (e.g., 'Red', 'XL', 'Matte').

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: UTC timestamp for value mapping creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: UTC timestamp for any value update.

models.name: shopping_mall_carts
models.description:
Customer shopping cart root entity.

Each cart is directly associated with an authenticated customer and serves as the persistent container for all shopping intents. Only one active cart exists per customer, preventing duplication. Carts are required for all add-to-cart and checkout flows, ensuring end-to-end state tracking and inventory validation within the platform. All items in the cart are managed through subsidiary cart item records. Deleted or checked-out carts are explicitly removed from the system.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Linked customer. References {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Cart creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last updated timestamp for cart state.

models.name: shopping_mall_cart_items
models.description:
Individual item records within a shopping cart.

Each record represents a single SKU in a customer's cart, including the desired quantity. Cart items are always associated with a parent cart and directly reference the intended product SKU. Only one cart item is allowed per SKU, per cart; duplicates are prevented by a composite unique constraint. This design enforces clean inventory operations, ensures correct add/remove/update logic, and supports multi-SKU carts. Cart items are always managed as part of their cart lifecycle.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_cart_id
foreignFields.description: Parent cart reference. {@link shopping_mall_carts.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_sku_id
foreignFields.description: Target SKU. {@link shopping_mall_product_skus.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Desired quantity for this SKU in the cart. Must be positive and less than or equal to available inventory.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Cart item creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modified timestamp.

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlists
models.description:
Customer wishlist root entity for persistent product interest.

Each wishlist is owned by a single customer and contains items representing SKUs the customer is interested in but does not intend to purchase immediately. Each customer has at most one wishlist. Wishlists persist through account sessions and device changes, helping customers track and later revisit interesting products. Items in the wishlist are managed as subsidiary records.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Linked customer. References {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Wishlist creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for the wishlist.

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlist_items
models.description:
Individual wishlist items attached to a customer's wishlist.

Each wishlist item represents a product SKU the customer is interested in saving for later. Items are linked both to the parent wishlist and the referenced SKU. No duplicate SKUs are allowed within a single wishlist, ensured by composite unique constraint. This enables efficient wishlist management and migration to cart flows when the customer decides to purchase. Item addition and removal is always managed as part of the wishlist lifecycle.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_wishlist_id
foreignFields.description: Parent wishlist. References {@link shopping_mall_wishlists.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_sku_id
foreignFields.description: SKU referenced by this wishlist item. {@link shopping_mall_product_skus.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Wishlist item creation timestamp.

models.name: shopping_mall_orders
models.description:
Represents the primary order entity for all purchases made on the platform.

Captures the high-level details of each order submitted by a customer, including references to the customer placing the order, the shipping address, and relevant payment and seller information. Orders serve as the anchor for all associated items, shipments, status changes, and audit logs. Multiple items and shipments may be related to one order, reflecting multi-SKU, multi-seller, and split-shipment scenarios. This model is independently managed and forms the primary lifecycle entity for all order operations. All temporal fields support robust audit trails and soft deletion as needed.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: References the purchasing customer. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_address_id
foreignFields.description: The delivery address for this order. {@link shopping_mall_addresses.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Main seller responsible for this order (single-seller context). {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: order_number
plainFields.description: Platform-unique business order number, used for external references and customer support. Example: ORD202500001.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current platform order status: e.g., pending, paid, cancelled, shipped, delivered, refunded.

plainFields.name: total_amount
plainFields.description: Final order total amount including all items, taxes, shipping, and discounts if any.

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: Currency code (ISO 4217). E.g., USD, KRW.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Order creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for this order.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; null if order is active.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_items
models.description:
Stores the breakdown of each order into per-SKU, per-product items.

Each record represents a unique product/SKU that is part of a given order, allowing complete normalization of order contents for inventory, fulfillment, analytics, and post-order processing. This model enables accurate tracking of quantities, price per SKU, refunds at item level, and inventory movements. Items are grouped under their parent order but retain individual references for fulfillment and shipment attachment.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Parent order to which this item belongs. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: The ordered product. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_sku_id
foreignFields.description: The specific SKU (variant) purchased. {@link shopping_mall_product_skus.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of units of this SKU ordered.

plainFields.name: unit_price
plainFields.description: Unit price at time of order for this SKU (discounts included, if any).

plainFields.name: subtotal
plainFields.description: Subtotal before order-level adjustments for this item (quantity × unit_price).

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: Currency code (ISO 4217). E.g., USD, KRW.

plainFields.name: delivered
plainFields.description: True if this item has been marked as delivered in fulfillment tracking.

plainFields.name: refunded
plainFields.description: True if this item has been refunded through returns/workflow.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Order item creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at

models.name: shopping_mall_order_shipments
models.description:
Represents a shipment or fulfillment batch associated with one or more items in an order.

Tracks the logistics information for each discrete shipment event—supporting split orders, multi-package delivery, and real-time tracking for both customers and sellers. Shipments reference the order, designated shipping partner, external tracking information, shipped and expected delivery dates, and status. This table enables precise management of complex fulfillment and last-mile delivery workflows.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order associated with this shipment. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_shipping_partner_id
foreignFields.description: Linked shipping partner. {@link shopping_mall_shipping_partners.id}.

plainFields.name: tracking_number
plainFields.description: Shipping partner/tracking-provided unique tracking number for this shipment.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Shipment status: e.g., pending, shipped, in_transit, delivered, returned.

plainFields.name: ship_date
plainFields.description: Date the shipment was handed to logistics partner; null if not yet shipped.

plainFields.name: expected_delivery_date
plainFields.description: Expected or promised delivery date; may be null if unknown.

plainFields.name: delivered_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of confirmed arrival; null if not delivered.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Shipment creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for this shipment.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; null if shipment is active.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_status_histories
models.description:
Historical log of all order status transitions and major business state changes for audit and workflow compliance.

Each entry represents a snapshot of the order's state at a point in time, retaining the entire status, comment, actor (user/admin/system), and timestamp. Enables strict traceability for business, legal, and operational purposes.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order associated with this status transition. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: actor_admin_id

foreignFields.name: actor_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who performed this action, if applicable. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: actor_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who performed this action, if applicable. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: from_status
plainFields.description: Previous status before transition.

plainFields.name: to_status
plainFields.description: New status after transition.

plainFields.name: comment
plainFields.description: Optional business or workflow comment entered by the actor or system.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of this status transition.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_audit_logs
models.description:
Append-only audit log recording every significant action or update along the lifecycle of orders.

Includes irreversible change events, actor, timestamp, action details, context, and (optionally) snapshot data for business process compliance and security. Ensures all activity affecting order lifecycle can be traced for investigation and legal defense. Not intended for deletion or modification post-recording.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order associated with this audit event. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: actor_admin_id

foreignFields.name: actor_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who performed this action, if applicable. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: actor_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who performed this action, if applicable. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Type of audited action (e.g., status_change, address_update, refund_initiated).

plainFields.name: details_json
plainFields.description: Optional serialized details/context for this action in JSON form.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp (UTC) when this audit event was recorded.

models.name: shopping_mall_payments
models.description:
Primary payment record for all customer orders processed by the shopping mall platform.

Represents an initiated or completed payment against one or more orders. Stores amounts, currency, payment method type, status, and provider references. Tracks external payment provider transaction IDs, internal tokens, and acts as the main business entity for all financial flows within the system.

Captures associated actor (customer or seller) and references the payment provider integration. Interaction with refunds, status tracking, and audit log tables are mediated by this entity. Soft deletion supported for audit and compliance.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: References the customer making the payment. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: provider_id
foreignFields.description: References the external payment provider through which payment is processed. {@link shopping_mall_external_payment_providers.id}.

plainFields.name: amount
plainFields.description: Decimal amount of the payment, in the currency indicated.

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction (e.g., USD, KRW, EUR).

plainFields.name: method_type
plainFields.description: Type of payment method used (e.g., card, e-wallet, bank_transfer, etc).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current payment status. Values include: initiated, pending, authorized, rejected, completed, refunded, failed.

plainFields.name: external_payment_id
plainFields.description: Payment transaction identifier assigned by the external payment provider. Used for reconciliation and callbacks.

plainFields.name: transaction_token
plainFields.description: Opaque unique token for idempotent processing; generated by system.

plainFields.name: requested_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when payment was initially requested.

plainFields.name: processed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of payment provider processor's definitive result (success/failure/refund).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null when active.

models.name: shopping_mall_payment_refunds
models.description:
Record of all payment refunds issued through the platform, referencing both the original payment and payment provider response.

Stores refund reason, processed amount, status, and external identifiers. Allows detailed audit and reporting of all refund events for compliance and business review.

Each refund is linked to a payment and has temporal tracking for request, processing, and finalization. Soft delete allows for audit-log recovery but prohibits actual data destruction.

foreignFields.name: payment_id
foreignFields.description: References the original payment record being refunded. {@link shopping_mall_payments.id}.

foreignFields.name: processed_by_admin_id
foreignFields.description: If refunded manually or escalated, references the admin actor who performed the refund. Nullable; null if system or automated refund.

plainFields.name: amount
plainFields.description: Amount refunded (fully or partially), in the same currency as the original payment.

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the refund.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided for the refund (e.g., cancellation, item not delivered, pricing error, admin corrective action, etc).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Refund status. E.g.: requested, pending, processing, completed, failed, rejected.

plainFields.name: external_refund_id
plainFields.description: Refund transaction identifier from the payment provider, for traceability and provider-side reconciliation.

plainFields.name: requested_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when refund was requested.

plainFields.name: processed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when refund processing completed, failed, or was finalized.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null when active.

models.name: shopping_mall_payment_statuses
models.description:
Represents immutable status snapshots for all payment transactions, capturing the historical state changes for auditing and compliance.

Each row documents state change events (pending, authorized, failed, refunded, completed, etc.), who/what triggered the change, and the time of transition. Not directly manageable by users; created by payment system or admin actors for a given payment lifecycle.

foreignFields.name: payment_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to payment whose status is being transitioned. {@link shopping_mall_payments.id}.

foreignFields.name: changed_by_admin_id
foreignFields.description: References admin who directly triggered payment status change. Nullable; null if automated/system actor.

plainFields.name: old_status
plainFields.description: Previous payment status value prior to this status change.

plainFields.name: new_status
plainFields.description: The new status applied as a result of this transition (e.g., pending, authorized, completed, failed, refunded, etc).

plainFields.name: changed_reason
plainFields.description: Reason or reference for the status transition, e.g., 'provider callback', 'manual review', 'automatic escalation'.

plainFields.name: changed_at
plainFields.description: Status change event timestamp.

models.name: shopping_mall_payment_audit_logs
models.description:
Immutable audit log record for all system or manual actions affecting payment records within the payment component.

Captures details of actions such as payment/reversal/refund events, provider callbacks, admin interventions, or system escalations for forensic review and compliance purposes. Includes timestamp, actor, action type, raw payload, and references to affected payment or refund entities when relevant.

This table is not directly user-managed and is intended for admin and auditor review only.

foreignFields.name: payment_id
foreignFields.description: Link to payment affected by this action (if relevant). Nullable for generic audit entries.

foreignFields.name: payment_refund_id
foreignFields.description: Link to specific refund record affected (if relevant). Nullable for payment-only or system events.

foreignFields.name: actor_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin who performed the action, when applicable. Nullable if triggered by system.

foreignFields.name: actor_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller actor responsible for the action, when applicable. Nullable if triggered by other roles or system.

foreignFields.name: actor_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer actor responsible for the action, when applicable. Nullable if triggered by other roles or system.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Type of action performed (e.g., payment_created, payment_updated, refund_requested, provider_callback, admin_override, escalation, etc).

plainFields.name: action_payload
plainFields.description: Raw payload log of the event or API call (JSON-encoded for callbacks, requests, responses, etc).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Log creation timestamp; matches event time, always immutable.

models.name: shopping_mall_reviews
models.description:
Product reviews submitted by customers for products they have purchased, per order item/SKU.

Each review is created by a verified customer and is always linked to a specific order item and product SKU, ensuring that only actual purchases can generate reviews. The review includes rating reference, summary, body text, moderation status, withdrawal tracking, and full traceability to the session and customer for audit and abuse prevention. Reviews can exist in draft, published, or withdrawn states and are subject to content moderation.

Soft-deletion is supported, with moderation and withdrawal tracked via status history. This model is central to product feedback, search, and moderation workflows.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the customer who authored the review. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_session_id
foreignFields.description: Session during which the review was created. {@link shopping_mall_customer_sessions.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product that the review is about. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_sku_id
foreignFields.description: SKU of the product reviewed. {@link shopping_mall_product_skus.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order in which this review's product was purchased. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_item_id
foreignFields.description: Specific order item this review is linked to. {@link shopping_mall_order_items.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_rating_id
foreignFields.description: Rating record for this review and SKU. {@link shopping_mall_product_ratings.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Short summary/title of the review. Required for all published reviews.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Body text of the review. Minimum 10 characters, maximum 1000. Editable by customer within allowed window.

plainFields.name: is_draft
plainFields.description: Indicates if the review is a draft (not yet published).

plainFields.name: withdrawn_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp if the customer withdraws the review (soft delete for user-initiated removal).

plainFields.name: moderation_status
plainFields.description: Current moderation status (e.g., pending, approved, rejected, flagged).

plainFields.name: moderation_reason
plainFields.description: Optional field indicating the reason for rejection or flagging during moderation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: DateTime when the review was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update time for this review (includes customer edits and moderator actions).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete marker (for platform/admin removal or purge).

models.name: shopping_mall_review_responses
models.description:
Seller responses to customer reviews, visible alongside the original review.

Each response is created by the seller of the product reviewed, providing clarification, acknowledgment, or additional information in response to customer feedback. Each response is linked to the specific review and the seller account. 

Full traceability to session and seller is maintained for auditing. Only one response is allowed per review; responses can be edited or withdrawn by seller or admin. Moderation is supported via status and reason fields.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_review_id
foreignFields.description: Unique link to the review being responded to. One response per review. {@link shopping_mall_reviews.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who wrote the response. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_session_id
foreignFields.description: Session during which the response was written. {@link shopping_mall_seller_sessions.id}.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Textual response from seller. Minimum 10, maximum 1000 characters.

plainFields.name: withdrawn_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp if seller withdraws or deletes their response.

plainFields.name: moderation_status
plainFields.description: Current moderation status for the response.

plainFields.name: moderation_reason
plainFields.description: Optional reason for moderation action (rejection/flagging).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the response was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last updated time.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete marker (for admin/content removal).

models.name: shopping_mall_product_ratings
models.description:
Standalone product rating entity tied to a specific customer and product SKU.

Stores the numeric (1–5 stars) rating value that a verified customer assigns to a product SKU as part of their review. Enforces the rule that each customer can rate each product SKU only once (per completed purchase). Ratings are referenced in reviews for search and aggregation; this separation allows display of rating stats even for unreviewed purchases and efficient rating aggregation per product/SKU.

Audit trail includes customer and session for verification. Only allows update by the original customer within the edit window.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who provided the rating. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_session_id
foreignFields.description: Session when the rating was submitted. {@link shopping_mall_customer_sessions.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product being rated. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_sku_id
foreignFields.description: SKU of the rated product. {@link shopping_mall_product_skus.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order associated with this rating. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_item_id
foreignFields.description: Specific order item this rating applies to. {@link shopping_mall_order_items.id}.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Numeric rating value (1–5 stars).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of rating creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update time for rating.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete marker (if rating is removed or replaced).

models.name: shopping_mall_review_status_histories
models.description:
Snapshot table recording all moderation, withdrawal, and status events for a given review.

Each record represents a point-in-time event (such as publication, rejection, flagging, withdrawal) with full traceability to the actor (customer, seller, admin) and session responsible for the change. This enables a comprehensive audit history for each review, covering all moderation workflow steps and supporting business auditability and dispute resolution.

Designed as append-only for integrity, with immutable event data and related descriptions.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_review_id
foreignFields.description: The review affected by this status event. {@link shopping_mall_reviews.id}.

foreignFields.name: actor_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Optional: Customer who performed this action (if actor is a customer). {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: actor_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Optional: Seller who performed this action (if actor is a seller). {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: actor_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Optional: Admin who performed this action (if actor is an admin). {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

foreignFields.name: actor_session_id
foreignFields.description: Optional: Session in which the action was triggered. Session type matches the actor type. {@link shopping_mall_admin_sessions.id}.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: New status set for the review (e.g., created, published, rejected, flagged, withdrawn, deleted).

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Optional explanation for status change (e.g., admin notes or moderation reasoning).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the status event occurred.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_action_logs
models.description:
Record of every privileged or system-level action performed by admin actors across the platform.

Captures the immutable trace of all administrative actions, including user modifications, order overrides, dispute resolutions, and escalated interventions. Provides detailed attribution with actor, target entity, action type, and optional contextual notes.
Crucial for compliance audits, forensic analysis, dispute defense, and role-based access tracing. Each entry includes timestamp, responsible admin (FK), contextual references (which may be user, seller, order, product, etc.), and a required action category/type for grouped analysis.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin actor responsible for action. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Categorical type of admin action (e.g., user_suspend, order_refund, role_escalate, config_change). Enables grouped analysis of actions.

plainFields.name: context_info
plainFields.description: Optional JSON-encoded or text data providing additional context (object state, request params, results, etc.).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Time the admin action was performed.

models.name: shopping_mall_audit_logs
models.description:
Comprehensive audit log capturing sensitive and high-privilege platform events affecting compliance-relevant data.

Logs changes and accesses for critical operations (e.g., user PII changes, financial record updates, permission modifications, and security events). Includes full actor attribution, audit-relevant target entity, change type, risk classification, compliance tag, and immutable create timestamp.
Indispensable for regulatory reviews, incident response, and integrity verification of privileged or risky operations.

foreignFields.name: actor_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin actor responsible for audited event. Nullable if external system or automated (system process). {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

foreignFields.name: actor_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller actor if the audited event is seller-performed. Nullable if not relevant. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: actor_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer actor if the event was customer-performed. Nullable if not relevant. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: change_type
plainFields.description: Nature of audited change (e.g., access, update, delete, permission_change, data_export).

plainFields.name: risk_level
plainFields.description: Risk classification by business/policy (e.g., low, medium, high, critical).

plainFields.name: compliance_tag
plainFields.description: Compliance tag or business rule identifier justifying audit entry (e.g., GDPR_ARTICLE5, PCI_LOG, SOX_ACCESS).

plainFields.name: audit_detail
plainFields.description: Detailed info about the change; may be structured JSON or plain text depending on event type.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when audit entry was recorded.

models.name: shopping_mall_escalation_queues
models.description:
Business escalation event or platform dispute record requiring human/admin intervention, mediator assignment, or compliance workflow.

Captures unresolved or problematic events (customer complaints, seller issues, refund or return exceptions, policy breaches) that are in process or require investigation. Each entry tracks the initiating actor, responsible role/queue (e.g., admin, compliance), current status, escalation reason, priority, and resolution timestamps. Supports advanced filtering by status, queue, reason, and time for operational management and workflow automation.

foreignFields.name: initiator_actor_admin_id
foreignFields.description: ID of admin initiator for cases started by an admin. Nullable if not applicable. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

foreignFields.name: initiator_actor_seller_id
foreignFields.description: ID of seller initiator for cases started by a seller. Optional if not applicable. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: initiator_actor_customer_id
foreignFields.description: ID of customer initiator for cases started by a customer. Optional if not applicable. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: assigned_admin_id
foreignFields.description: ID of assigned admin handling the escalation. Null if auto/unassigned. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: escalation_type
plainFields.description: Business category for escalation (e.g., refund_dispute, policy_violation, compliance_check, complaint, delivery_exception).

plainFields.name: reason_detail
plainFields.description: Detailed explanation of why the event is escalated. Full business context for review.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current state in workflow (e.g., open, investigating, resolved, closed, rejected, admin_pending, compliance_review).

plainFields.name: priority
plainFields.description: Priority classification for triage (e.g., low, normal, high, urgent, critical).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when escalation was created.

plainFields.name: resolved_at
plainFields.description: Time when escalation was closed/resolved (nullable until resolved).

plainFields.name: last_updated_at
plainFields.description: Time of last update (status/assignment change, message, etc.).

models.name: shopping_mall_refund_requests
models.description:
Customer-initiated refund requests for orders or items within the shopping mall platform.

Each record represents a formal refund request made by a customer for an eligible order or order item. The table tracks request reasons, status, requested and actual refund amounts, associated actors (customer, seller, admin), and links to any associated dispute. It is integral to the resolution workflow for cancellations, returns, or disputes. All changes and outcomes are auditable and support regulatory compliance.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key linking refund request to the affected order. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who submitted the refund request. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller responsible for the transaction in dispute. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin involved in processing or decision for this refund request, if applicable. Nullable. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the refund request (pending, approved, rejected, cancelled, processing, refunded). Maintains workflow state.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Customer's reason for refund request, provided at submission.

plainFields.name: requested_amount
plainFields.description: Monetary amount requested for refund by the customer.

plainFields.name: approved_amount
plainFields.description: Amount approved for refund by admin or seller after review. Nullable until decision.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when refund request was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last modification (status update, note, etc.).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft-deletion. Nullable: present only if entity is logically deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_disputes
models.description:
Dispute cases arising from refund requests, order problems, or other escalated issues involving customers, sellers, or admins.

Each row represents a distinct dispute, tracking its origin (linked refund request if applicable), actor roles, status, subject, root cause, resolution notes, and all necessary context to drive resolution workflow. Supports escalation, decision, and full audit trail for compliance and platform governance.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_refund_request_id
foreignFields.description: Original refund request linked to this dispute, if applicable. Nullable. {@link shopping_mall_refund_requests.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer involved in the dispute. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller involved in the dispute. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin handling or mediating the dispute. Nullable. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Dispute status: open, investigating, resolved, rejected, escalated, closed.

plainFields.name: subject
plainFields.description: Short, business-driven description of the dispute's subject (e.g., 'Non-delivery', 'Item not as described').

plainFields.name: root_cause
plainFields.description: Primary cause or issue leading to the dispute, as assessed by actors or admin.

plainFields.name: resolution_note
plainFields.description: Final resolution details or decision note from admin. Nullable until decision.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of dispute creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last updated timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-deletion timestamp. Nullable.

models.name: shopping_mall_dispute_histories
models.description:
Append-only historical audit log of all significant status changes and actions performed during the dispute lifecycle.

Each record captures a snapshot of status, involved actors, timestamps, and relevant notes whenever the dispute transitions through workflow stages. Enables full traceability for compliance, security, and retrospective analytics.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_dispute_id

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_actor_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller responsible for this action (may be null if other actor).

plainFields.name: status

plainFields.name: note

plainFields.name: created_at

models.name: shopping_mall_dispute_messages
models.description:
All direct messages exchanged between actors (customer, seller, admin) within the context of a specific dispute.

Each row represents an individual message, including sender/receiver, message content, role, temporal data, and linkage to the dispute. Supports threaded, auditable communication as part of the escalation and negotiation process.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_dispute_id
foreignFields.description: Link to parent dispute for this message. {@link shopping_mall_disputes.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_sender_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin user who sent this message (nullable if another actor).

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_sender_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who sent this message (nullable if another actor).

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_sender_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who sent this message (nullable if another actor).

foreignFields.description: Admin user receiving this message (nullable if another actor).

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_receiver_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who received this message (nullable if another actor).

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_receiver_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who received this message (nullable if another actor).

plainFields.name: role
plainFields.description: Role of sender (admin, seller, customer) for easy filtering.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Body of the message as exchanged within the dispute.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when message was sent.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-deletion timestamp. Present only if message is logically deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_shipments
models.description:
Shipment records for order fulfillment and logistics event tracking.

Captures all shipment detail for order items shipped via any integrated partner, including references to orders, order items, the selected carrier, label/tracking numbers, shipping status, and API/provider result codes. Used for both platform-initiated and manual shipments by sellers or admins.

Provides full auditability with actor attribution (who created/updated/cancelled), label/manifest data, and timestamps for each shipment event.

foreignFields.name: order_id
foreignFields.description: Order this shipment is part of. References {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: order_item_id
foreignFields.description: Specific item in the order that this shipment fulfills. References {@link shopping_mall_order_items.id}.

foreignFields.name: shipping_partner_id
foreignFields.description: Shipping/logistics provider handling this shipment. References {@link shopping_mall_shipping_partners.id}.

foreignFields.name: created_by_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin who created this shipment record, if automated. Nullable; present if admin assigned the carrier.

foreignFields.name: created_by_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who created or fulfilled this shipment, if not auto-assigned. Nullable; present if the seller itself handed off to carrier.

plainFields.name: carrier_tracking_code
plainFields.description: Carrier-assigned or external shipment/tracking code/number for reference to shipping label or manifest. Nullable for shipments where code is not yet issued.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current shipment status. Valid values: pending, ready, picked_up, in_transit, delivered, cancelled, returned. Status transitions follow fulfillment and return lifecycle rules.

plainFields.name: manifest_url
plainFields.description: Optional download URI for shipping label or manifest provided by the carrier. Nullable if not supported.

plainFields.name: provider_response_code
plainFields.description: Last received status code/result from the API provider (success/fail/integration result, if any). Nullable if no API call made yet.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the shipment record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to the shipment record.

plainFields.name: delivery_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the shipment was marked as delivered by the carrier or customer. Nullable if not yet delivered.

plainFields.name: cancelled_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp if/when this shipment was cancelled. Nullable if not cancelled.

models.name: shopping_mall_shipment_tracking_histories
models.description:
Chronological tracking updates and carrier event logs for each shipment.

Captures a complete, append-only history of carrier-side/warehouse-side shipment updates from dispatch to delivery. All status changes, tracking location events, and relevant carrier messages with actors, timestamps, geo-coordinates, provider event codes, and free-form tracking text are stored here.

Serves as an audit trail and full shipment journey visibility for platform users and admins. Accessible only via the parent shipment, never directly edited or deleted by users.

foreignFields.name: shipment_id
foreignFields.description: Shipment that this tracking event belongs to. References {@link shopping_mall_shipments.id}.

plainFields.name: event_time
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the tracking event as provided by the carrier or system.

plainFields.name: location
plainFields.description: Reported location (e.g., city, depot, or delivery point) for this event. Nullable if not provided by carrier.

plainFields.name: latitude
plainFields.description: Latitude coordinate attached to the event, if available. Nullable.

plainFields.name: longitude
plainFields.description: Longitude coordinate attached to the event, if available. Nullable.

plainFields.name: event_code
plainFields.description: Provider-specific event code (e.g., OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, DELIVERED, HELD, etc.). Nullable for free-form events.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Status code at this event step (e.g., pending, in_transit, delivered, exception, returned). Used for shipment status timeline.

plainFields.name: tracking_message
plainFields.description: Full carrier or system-provided message as shown to both admins and customers for shipment progress updates.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this tracking event record was created in the platform DB.

models.name: shopping_mall_return_requests
models.description:
Return, pickup, and shipment reverse logistics request records.

Captures customer- or seller-initiated requests to return or pick up delivered items, including reason, status, actor attribution, scheduled pickup, and all carrier/shipment integration info. Enables tracking of the full lifecycle of returns from customer submission to carrier pickup, delivery to warehouse, and completion/cancellation.

Return requests are linked to specific order items and can be referenced in refund or dispute management. All requested actions are audit-trailed including user/actor IDs and timestamps for resolution.

foreignFields.name: order_id
foreignFields.description: Order this return request refers to. References {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: order_item_id
foreignFields.description: Order item being returned or picked up. References {@link shopping_mall_order_items.id}.

foreignFields.name: requested_by_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer requesting the return or pickup. Nullable if request was not customer-initiated.

foreignFields.name: requested_by_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller requesting return/pickup (for defective goods, etc.). Nullable if not applicable.

foreignFields.name: shipping_partner_id
foreignFields.description: Shipping partner assigned to the return/pickup. Nullable until carrier is selected.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Free-form reason for return or pickup provided by the actor (customer, seller, or admin). Displayed in detail views and tracking.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the return/pickup request. Valid values: pending, approved, scheduled, picked_up, delivered, completed, rejected, cancelled. Required for workflow state machine.

plainFields.name: pickup_address
plainFields.description: Address where the item should be picked up (defaults to order delivery address if omitted). Nullable if carrier not yet assigned.

plainFields.name: scheduled_pickup_at
plainFields.description: Scheduled date/time for the carrier to pick up the item (timezone: Asia/Seoul). Nullable if not scheduled yet.

plainFields.name: provider_tracking_code
plainFields.description: Tracking code or RMA from the shipping partner for this pickup/return. Nullable until assigned.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the return request was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update to the return request record.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this return/pickup request was fully completed (goods delivered to warehouse/refund processed). Nullable until finished.

plainFields.name: cancelled_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp if/when this return/pickup request was cancelled. Nullable if not cancelled.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Nullable; when present, marks this record as soft deleted, for audit/history recovery.
